rationale: design-audit: the value-level design audit. It runs on every pull request (soft, never gating) and on dispatch; only a dispatch lands a harness_runs row, because a pull request job must not hold the production service credential. One run is one dispatch of design-audit.yml. Registered so the workflow records its own run (CLAUDE.md rule 17) and the closure gate's NEVER-RUN check reads the ledger row; the artifact is emitted by scripts/lib/emit-workflow-run-artifact.mjs from the workflow's own record job.
